label: r04-F-T3-7
critiques: The trial prompt tells the operator to "Run exactly one shell command" and to "Do not open, list, search, or read any file. Do not look inside spe/ or any other folder". The predictions, grade.py, answers.json and judge.md all sit under spe/. Validation also throws if a ticket carries category, priority, label, or reference, and selfReportLeak voids any trial whose commands touch KEY_MARKERS.

args.only switches the script to a DRY mode that runs only the listed cells. Gate four in the paragraph launches that dry run on three cells before the full launch and requires every trial to pass schema, leak scan, grading, and tone scoring.

The paragraph's second gate runs `grade.py --selftest`, which must pass the oracle answers and fail the empty and wrong answers. The third gate regrades spe/evals/results/r03.json with this round's grader and compares it to the recorded round 3 scores "as the control".

CAP_USD defaults to 40, and the launch passes spendCapUsd: 40. tryReserve runs before every trial and judge call. It refuses work once spent plus reserved plus the next cost would pass the cap, logs "Spend cap $40 would be crossed. Skipping...", and adds each skipped item to budget.skipped. That list goes into the final report.

Labels are graded by running grade.py against answers.json, and the grader agent is told "You do not grade anything yourself". The Opus judge is told to "Score tone only. Do not score whether the category, the priority, or the facts are right."
The Top-up phase picks cells where 0 < main_passes < main_scored. It adds up to TOPUP_PER_CELL (3) trials to each cell under a TOPUP_TOTAL cap of 60, and it logs any cells left without a top-up.
The Synthesis phase runs a failure-analysis agent and then a completeness-critic agent. The round comes from the single argument args.round, which sets ROUND and ROUND_ID and throws if it is missing.
